name: Alert
description: An inline feedback banner with semantic variants, an optional title, and dismissal.
usage:
<Alert variant="warning" title="Payment method expiring">
  The workspace card ends in 04/25. Update billing details to avoid interruption.
</Alert>

anatomy.description: Decorative severity glyph, hidden from assistive technology.
Optional bold lead-in naming the condition.
The explanatory message; wraps within the surface.
Optional labeled IconButton rendered when onDismiss is passed.

dos: Keep the alert mounted until the condition resolves or the user dismisses it.
Use the danger variant for failures that need immediate attention; it announces assertively.
donts: Don't use Alert for brief confirmations; use Toast instead.
Don't rely on the icon or color alone; the text must carry the meaning.

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: Semantic variants pair a standard icon with a matching surface treatment.

examples.title: Dismissible
examples.description: Pass onDismiss to render a close button for feedback the user can clear.

guidance.useWhen: Feedback must stay visible in context until it is read or dismissed.
guidance.avoidWhen: A brief confirmation is enough; use a toast for transient feedback.
guidance.behavior: Danger renders role="alert" for immediate announcement; other variants render role="status".
guidance.responsive: Let the body text wrap and keep the title to a short phrase.

notes: Danger renders role="alert" so the message is announced immediately; other variants render role="status".
The variant icon is decorative and hidden from assistive technology; meaning is carried by the text.
The dismiss control is a labeled button in the normal tab order.

props.description: Icon override; defaults to the variant's standard icon. Always hidden from assistive technology.
props.name: icon

props.description: Renders a dismiss button and calls this when it is pressed.
props.name: onDismiss

props.description: Bold leading text of the alert.
props.name: title
